exposedFields.title: Exposed fields
exposedFields.description: Names of the hidden custom fields to expose, separated by commas. Put a name that contains a comma in double quotes, for example: External ID, "Fix versions, legacy"

serviceToken.title: Technical user token
serviceToken.description: Permanent token of the technical user that can see the hidden fields. It needs read access to the issues, plus Update Issue if callers should update exposed fields. Never use an administrator.

allowedGroup.title: Allowed group
allowedGroup.description: Optional. Name of a group; when set, only its members can read and update the exposed fields. If no group has this name, nobody can.

youtrackUrl.title: YouTrack base URL
youtrackUrl.description: Optional. The URL the app uses to call the YouTrack REST API. Leave empty to use the URL from issue links.

mcpEnabled.title: MCP tools
mcpEnabled.description: Turn off to refuse every call to the app's MCP tools. They still appear in MCP clients' tool lists.

attachedRestEnabled.title: REST endpoints in attached projects
attachedRestEnabled.description: Turn off to refuse every call to /api/issues/{id}/extensionEndpoints/hidden-fields/api/issue.

globalRestEnabled.title: App-wide REST endpoints
globalRestEnabled.description: Turn off to refuse every call to /api/extensionEndpoints/hidden-fields/global/issue, which works in every project, attached or not.
